_comment_1: Copy to dart_define.local.json (gitignored), then run: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=dart_define.local.json. scripts/setup.sh does the copy for you.
_comment_2: As shipped this file runs the app in OFFLINE mode: no Firebase project, no keys, no network. Every screen works against local demo data. Leave it exactly as-is if you only want to see the app run.
_comment_3: To connect a real Firebase project: fill the five RUNIAC_FIREBASE_* values below, then flip RUNIAC_FIREBASE_PRODUCTION to "true". Flipping it to "true" while any of those four required values is still empty makes the app throw StateError on launch, on purpose — a half-configured backend must fail loudly rather than look like it worked.
_comment_4: MAPBOX_PUBLIC_ACCESS_TOKEN is independent of Firebase. Without it, map surfaces render their placeholder instead of live tiles; everything else is unaffected.
